name: Crush
description: Each creature Orlassk is currently grappling must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (3d12) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it is obliterated into dust.
